answer: Referral Drag Ledger. Each new identity must be sponsored by an existing one, and the sponsor's future payouts decay in proportion to how many identities it has already sponsored. An honest operator's referrals stay few and their dividend stays high; a cloner's payout per clone falls sharply as the clone count grows, so mass identity creation costs more in forfeited sponsor income than each clone can earn. Any walnut of a clone farm loses money at scale. A pulse of new identities from one sponsor is taxed at the margin. That dune of fake accounts becomes unprofitable long before it matters.
